//: Typechecks the standalone bundle, which nothing else does: the ROOT tsconfig excludes standalone/ on purpose (so Vercel's Next build never tries to resolve its vite imports), and `vite build` uses esbuild, which STRIPS types without checking them. Without this file, everything under src/ — including the CrazyGames SDK binding — ships unverified. Run it with `npm --prefix standalone run typecheck`; it is never part of the Next/Vercel build.
